name: text-to-reality
description: Give your agent the power to build real things. text-to-reality turns an idea into a device anyone can build by following pictures: parts list, 3D-printed parts, wiring, code, a step-by-step picture guide and tests. Runs locally; no account or API key.

interface.shortDescription: Turn an idea into a device anyone can build
interface.longDescription: Give your agent the power to build real things. text-to-reality turns an idea into a device anyone can build by following pictures: parts list, 3D-printed parts, wiring, code, a step-by-step picture guide and tests. Runs locally; no account or API key.
defaultPrompt: Build me a little desk screen that shows my Claude usage.
Make a plant-watering reminder with a soil sensor and a light, no soldering.
Turn my ESP32 and this OLED into a desk clock I can 3D print a case for.
